targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: 2026-07-22 (V3-EXQ-708a, diagnostic, claim_ids=[MECH-440], non_contributory -- weights nothing; failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-708a_2026-07-22). The V3-EXQ-708 instrument repair WORKED: 862 genuinely-fresh E3 select() calls against a floor of 30, 4 divergent seeds, supra-floor and non-trivial-vs-raw noise bias range (0.221), live dACC suppression, dissociable finer channels. MECH-440 was nonetheless not tested, for a new and SUBSTANTIVE reason: neither designed lever moves the dependent variable. ARM_TEMP raises pre-commit sampling-class entropy above A0_OFF on 0 of 4 divergent seeds and ARM_NOISE_SINGLE on 1 of 4, against a bar of 2. With no injected pre-commit variance there is nothing for the propagation question to observe. This is a failed MANIPULATION CHECK on a demonstrably working instrument, not an unready substrate -- the precondition_unmet flag cannot presently distinguish the two, since both are kind:readiness. Two readings are live and are NOT separable from this manifest, which records only the between-arm entropy delta: (i) the pre-commit distribution is already saturated/argmax-like and has no headroom -- the F-dominance signature, now observed PRE-commit; or (ii) the levers are applied downstream of where the pre-commit distribution is formed. Route to 708b recording pre-commit distribution SHAPE (max_prob, effective support, per-candidate mass) per arm per seed, which discriminates them. measurement_gap, explicitly NOT substrate_ceiling. MECH-440 stays candidate / v3_pending; pending_retest_after_substrate NOT set (no substrate build is owed yet).

suggested_probes.sketch: Record the pre-commit distribution's SHAPE per select -- max_prob, effective support (participation ratio), per-candidate mass summary -- per arm per seed. Declared null: max_prob is near 1 in EVERY arm including A0_OFF, i.e. no headroom exists for any lever.

Assert at the E3 call site that the temperature and weight-noise perturbations are applied upstream of the pre-commit softmax, and record the applied value. Declared null: max_prob differs by arm while entropy does not, i.e. the lever arrives but the entropy readout is blind to it.

fanout_recommendation.note: GOV-FANOUT-1: a discrimination between a substrate property and a wiring defect, on different axes (measurement vs instrumentation). Both are settled by ONE re-run that adds both readouts, so the portfolio is a single experiment with two declared nulls rather than two experiments.

learning_extracted: SUBSTANTIVE FINDING: with a repaired, demonstrably-adequate instrument (862 fresh selects vs a floor of 30), NEITHER a temperature perturbation NOR supra-floor weight noise raises pre-commit sampling-class entropy on a strict majority of divergent seeds (0/4 and 1/4 against a bar of 2). A property of the system, not a readiness failure.

A failed MANIPULATION CHECK on a working instrument is not the same as an unready substrate, and the precondition_unmet flag cannot tell them apart -- both are kind:readiness. Proposed schema distinction: kind:readiness (was the setup adequate) vs kind:manipulation_check (did the lever move anything). Only the first should self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue.

The 708 instrument repair is validated and reusable: clear-before-select_action plus record-only-if-repopulated (from v3_exq_785a, lifted into _lib at ree-v3 08e9955) delivered 862 fresh selects where 708 had pure pseudo-replication.
Measurement gap, NOT recording gap: the pre-commit distribution shape was never computed, so this needs a new readout rather than recording more of what already existed.
